Question Choices: Fill: A right triangle has hypotenuse 25 and one leg 7. Find the other leg.
Solution: The hypotenuse is 25, and the known leg is 7. Missing leg²=25²−7²=625−49=576. Take the positive square root: 24. Check: 7²+(24)²=25².

Hints: The ladder forms the hypotenuse of a right triangle
Solution: The wall and level ground meet at 90°, so the ladder is the hypotenuse. Identify the two perpendicular legs as 6 and 8. Hypotenuse²=6²+8²=36+64=100. A length is positive, so the hypotenuse is√100=10. It is longer than either leg.

Solution: Horizontal change=4−(-2)=6; vertical change=-5−(3)=-8. Distance²=(6)²+(-8)²=100. Distance is the positive root, √100=10 units.
